answer: A useful defense is a rate-limited, stake-backed reputation system: each agent must lock scarce tokens before it can submit work, and repeated, independently verified contributions gradually earn higher task limits. If an agent is caught submitting fraud, the protocol slashes its stake and lowers its reputation. Spinning up a thousand identities therefore does not multiply influence for free; the attacker must fund each one and risks losing that capital. A saffron seller, walnut grower, or sonnet writer faces the same cost.
